title: Smaller Shears & Fishin Rod
description: Smaller more Minimalistic Shears and Fishing Rod
body:
Minimal Tools — Description

A clean and simple texture pack that reduces the size of shears and the fishing rod for a more minimal, less intrusive look. Designed for players who prefer compact tool icons, cleaner visuals, and a lightweight, polished UI. Fully faithful to Minecraft’s vanilla style — just smaller and cleaner.![Smaller more Minimalistic Shears and Fishing Rod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da0de443935414ff0d64be36f8e0b873d9337663_0.webp)
